nodes.text:
📊 WWSCAN Weekly Data:

Respiratory weekly update:SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A, Influenza B, and RSV are in the “High” category nationwide. The other respiratory viruses (HMPV and EV-D68) we monitor remain in the “Low” wastewater category nationwide and not in seasonal onset.  🛟😷🧪 https://t.co/ATtMlcDfzN

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text:
📊 WWSCAN Weekly Data:

COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the “High” category with medium concentrations and an upward trend over the last 3 weeks. 🛟😷🧪 https://t.co/BnZfCOrlzk

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 📊 WWSCAN Weekly Data:  COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we see  KP.1 variant in light green (37.9%) & KP.3 in light blue (16.7%) make up approximately 55% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. 🛟😷🧪 https://t.co/oq4GLb17BW

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text:
📊 WWSCAN Weekly Data:

Influenza: Nationally, Flu A is in the “High” category with high concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. Flu B is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations and an upward trend over the last 3 weeks.
🛟😷🧪 https://t.co/2rLq2JMdFf

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text:
📊 WWSCAN Weekly Data:

H5 influenza marker: H5 detected in 24 states since monitoring began - 5 in West, 7 in Midwest, 6 in South, & 6 in Northeast. As of 3/19/25, 17 states report infected cattle herds. Recent wastewater detections in CA, FL, KY, MA, MN, NH, NJ, UT, & VT.🛟😷🧪 https://t.co/z9taZJfXVl

nodes.text:
📊 WWSCAN Weekly Data:

RSV:  RSV is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations with no trend up or down over the last 3 weeks. 🛟😷🧪 https://t.co/23X6qebvNp

HMPV: HMPV is in the “Low” category nationally, but is in onset and in the “High” category in some regions (West and Northeast). 🛟😷🧪 https://t.co/FvVlGjiG2l
